【定位】Perhaps more important, as the global economy continues to be disrupted by technology and other massive change, the gig economy will itself become an engine of economic and social transformation. 或许更重要的是，随着全球经济持续被技术和其他剧变所颠覆，零工经济本身将成为经济与 社会变革的引擎。

【选项】A) 过度推断 A项It may force companies to reform their business practice.说零工经济会"迫 使企业改革其业务实践"，原文并未提到"迫使企业改革"这一动作，create a bridge between traditional enterprises and this emerging economy说的是搭桥而非迫使 改革。 B) 与原文相反 B项It may soon replace the traditional economic model.说零工经济会"很快取代传 统经济模式"，原文里始终是"搭桥""成为引擎"，从未表达替代关系。 C) 与原文相反（因果颠倒） C项It will drive technological progress on a global scale.说零工经济"将驱动全球技 术进步"，但原文里是"global economy被technology颠覆"，技术是动因、零工经济是 结果之一，方向被反过来。 D) ✓ 正确 the gig economy will itself become an engine of economic and social transformation ↔ It will bring about radical economic and social changes. 从预判"将带来经济与社会变革"出发，D项把engine of transformation改写成bring about radical changes，逐字段语义匹配，是定位句的直接同义替换。

items.paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.passage:
P1 Boredom has become trendy. Studies point to how boredom is good for creativity and innovation, as well as mental health. It is found that people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task. When people are bored, they have an increase in "associative thought"—the process of making new connections between ideas, which is linked to innovative thinking. These studies are impressive, but in reality, the benefits of boredom may be related to having time to clear your mind, be quiet, or daydream.

P2 In our stimulation-rich world, it seems unrealistic that boredom could occur at all. Yet, there are valid reasons boredom may feel so painful. As it turns out, boredom might signal the fact that you have a need that isn't being met.

P3 Our always-on world of social media may result in more connections, but they are superficial and can get in the way of building a real sense of belonging. Feeling bored may signal the desire for a greater sense of community and the feeling that you fit in with others around you. So take the step of joining an organization to build face-to-face relationships. You'll find depth that you won't get from your screen no matter how many likes you get on your post.

P4 Similar to the need for belonging, bored people often report that they feel a limited sense of meaning. It's a fundamental human need to have a larger purpose and to feel like we're part of something bigger than ourselves. When people are bored, they're more likely to feel less meaning in their lives. If you want to reduce boredom and increase your sense of meaning, seek work where you can make a unique contribution, or find a cause you can support with your time and talent.

P5 If your definition of boredom is being quiet, mindful, and reflective, keep it up. But if you're struggling with real boredom and the emptiness it provokes, consider whether you might seek new connections and more significant challenges. These are the things that will genuinely relieve boredom and make you more effective in the process.

questions.q: What have studies found about boredom?
options: It facilitates innovative thinking.
It is a result of doing boring tasks.
It helps people connect with others.
It does harm to one's mental health.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What have studies found about boredom? 直接问研究的客观发现，未出现 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号

【拆句】现在完成时一般疑问句 What have studies found about boredom?，主干是 studies have found what about boredom；about boredom 是 found 的范围状语，结构平铺直 叙，无陷阱 46. What have studies found about boredom? A) It facilitates innovative thinking. B) It is a result of doing boring tasks. C) It helps people connect with others. D) It does harm to one's mental health.

【定位】Studies point to how boredom is good for creativity and innovation, as well as mental health. 研究指出无聊有益于创造力和创新（思维），也有益于心理健康。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 boredom is good for creativity and innovation ↔It facilitates innovative thinking. 预判的「无聊带来好处+创新」两要素在 It facilitates innovative thinking. 中都被 精确还原——facilitates 对应 is good for，innovative thinking 对应 creativity and innovation B) 与原文相反 原文说 people are more creative following the completion of a tedious task—— 是完成无聊任务之后人更有创造力，并非无聊本身是做无聊任务的结果；It is a result of doing boring tasks. 把因果方向倒过来，是典型的与原文相反 C) 无中生有 P1 谈的是无聊与创造力、创新、心理健康的关系，未提及无聊「帮人和他人连接」；It helps people connect with others. 的内容在 P1 中没有任何对应句 D) 与原文相反 原文明确说无聊 as well as mental health（与心理健康并列在 good for 之后，意为对 心理健康有益），It does harm to one's mental health. 说的是「有害」——评价极性 完全反转 作者说无聊可能表明什么? A) 需要独处。 B) 渴望得到满足。 C) 需要解决的冲突。 D) 需要被认可的感受。

questions.q: What does the author say boredom might indicate?
options: A need to be left alone.
A desire to be fulfilled.
A conflict to be resolved.
A feeling to be validated.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say boredom might indicate? 是对作者陈述的直接发问，无 推断或主旨信号

【拆句】宾语从句 What does the author say boredom might indicate?，主句 the author say + 宾语从句 boredom might indicate what；what 是宾语从句里 indicate 的宾语前移；结 构常见，无陷阱

【定位】As it turns out, boredom might signal the fact that you have a need that isn't being met. 事实证明，无聊可能是在告诉你：你有一种需求没有被满足。 47. What does the author say boredom might indicate? A) A need to be left alone. B) A desire to be fulfilled. C) A conflict to be resolved. D) A feeling to be validated.

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文未提「希望独处」；A need to be left alone. 是把后文 P3 关于「真实连接」的话 题反向推断出来的伪命题，但 P2 中根本没有这层意思 B) ✓ 正确 a need that isn't being met ↔A desire to be fulfilled. 预判的「需求+未被满足」两要素被 A desire to be fulfilled. 完整保留——desire 替换 need，to be fulfilled 替换被动定语从句 C) 偷换概念 A conflict to be resolved. 谈「冲突」，但 P2 全段未提任何 conflict（冲突）的概念 ——need 是「需求」不是「冲突」，两者不能等同 D) 偷换概念 A feeling to be validated. 说「需要被确认的感觉」，但原文说的是「需求未被满足」 ——「确认感觉」与「满足需求」不是一回事；validate 与 meet 不能等价替换 从文章中我们了解到关于社交媒体的什么情况? A) 它可能是拓展人际关系的障碍。 B) 它可能妨碍提升社会地位。 C) 它可能阻碍人们培养真正的社群归属感。 D) 它可能使人们觉得自己应该融入外部世界。

questions.q: What do we learn about social media from the passage?
options: It may be an obstacle to expanding one's connections.
It may get in the way of enhancing one's social status.
It may prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community.
It may make people feel that they ought to fit in with the outside world.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn about social media from the passage? 问文章告诉我们关于 social media 的什么事实，无推断或主旨信号

【拆句】一般疑问句 What do we learn about social media from the passage?，主干 we learn what about social media；from the passage 是状语，提示答案在文章里有明文，结构无 陷阱

【定位】Our always-on world of social media may result in more connections, but they are superficial and can get in the way of building a real sense of belonging. 我们这个永远在线的社交媒体世界可能带来更多连接，但这些连接是肤浅的，会妨碍建立真 正的归属感。 48. What do we learn about social media from the passage? A) It may be an obstacle to expanding one's connections. B) It may get in the way of enhancing one's social status. C) It may prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community. D) It may make people feel that they ought to fit in with the outside world.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文 may result in more connections 说的是社交媒体带来更多连接（在数量上扩 大），而 It may be an obstacle to expanding one's connections. 说它「妨碍扩大连 接」——评价方向反转 B) 偷换概念 原文未提 social status（社会地位）；It may get in the way of enhancing one's social status. 中「妨碍提升社会地位」在 P3 中无任何对应——social 一词共用但 status 完全没出现 C) ✓ 正确 can get in the way of building a real sense of belonging ↔ It may prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community. 预判的「妨碍」+「真正的归属感」两要素被 prevent people from developing a genuine sense of community 完整对应——动词短语、形容词、核心名词全部同步同 义替换 D) 偷换概念 It may make people feel that they ought to fit in with the outside world. 说「让人 觉得自己必须融入外部世界」，但原文 the feeling that you fit in with others around you 把 fit in 作为「归属感」的一部分（是好事），不是说社交媒体让人觉得「必须 迎合」 作者建议人们做什么来摆脱无聊? A) 计算他们的帖子获得的点赞数。 B) 反思他们与他人的关系。 C) 参与现实生活中的互动。 D) 参加在线讨论。

questions.q: What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom?
options: Count the likes they get on their posts.
Reflect on how they relate to others.
Engage in real-life interactions.
Participate in online discussions.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom? 问作者明文给 出的建议，无推断信号

【拆句】宾语从句 + 不定式状语 What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom?，主句 the author suggest + 宾语 people do what；to get rid of boredom 是目的状语；结构稍复杂但无陷阱

【定位】So take the step of joining an organization to build face-to-face relationships. You'll find depth that you won't get from your screen no matter how many likes you get on your post. 所以请采取行动，加入一个组织，去建立面对面的关系。你会从中获得屏幕给不了的深度 ——无论你的帖子收到多少点赞。 49. What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom? A) Count the likes they get on their posts. B) Reflect on how they relate to others. C) Engage in real-life interactions. D) Participate in online discussions.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文 no matter how many likes you get on your post 明确否定「数点赞」的价值； Count the likes they get on their posts. 反而把「数点赞」当作建议——完全反向 B) 答非所问 Reflect on how they relate to others. 说「反思自己如何与他人相处」，但作者的建议 是「采取行动加入组织」，不是「反思」；reflect 与 take action 是两种完全不同的应 对方式 C) ✓ 正确 build face-to-face relationships ↔Engage in real-life interactions. 预判的「面对面/线下」+「关系/互动」两要素被 Engage in real-life interactions. 整 体保留，且未做任何延伸 D) 与原文相反 Participate in online discussions. 说「参与线上讨论」——而原文恰恰让人远离屏 幕，转向 build face-to-face relationships；线上与线下方向反转 人们应该做什么来增强意义感? A) 尝试做一些原创的事情。 B) 面对重大挑战。 C) 以独特的方式定义无聊。 D) 致力于有价值的事业。

questions.q: What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning?
options: Try to do something original.
Confront significant challenges.
Define boredom in their unique way.
Devote themselves to a worthy cause.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning? 直接问该做什么，无 推断信号

【拆句】情态动词疑问句 + 不定式状语 What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning?，主干 people should do what；to enhance... 是目的状语；结构清晰，无 陷阱

【定位】If you want to reduce boredom and increase your sense of meaning, seek work where you can make a unique contribution, or find a cause you can support with your time and talent. 如果你想减少无聊、增强意义感，就去寻找一份你能做出独特贡献的工作，或者找到一项你 能用时间和才华去支持的事业。 50. What should people do to enhance their sense of meaning? A) Try to do something original. B) Confront significant challenges. C) Define boredom in their unique way. D) Devote themselves to a worthy cause.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 Try to do something original. 说「做原创的事」，但原文 make a unique contribution 强调的是「做独特贡献」——unique contribution（独特贡献）与 something original（原创之物）不是同一概念，前者强调贡献的「不可替代性」，后 者强调内容的「首创性」 B) 张冠李戴 Confront significant challenges. 说「直面重大挑战」，但 P4 通篇未提 challenge （挑战）；该词只在 more significant challenges 出现，是 P5 谈「摆脱无聊」的总建 议，不是 P4 谈「增强意义感」的具体做法 C) 答非所问 Define boredom in their unique way. 说「用自己独特的方式定义无聊」——这与题 目所问的「增强意义感」无关；该项把 If your definition of boredom is being quiet, mindful, and reflective 中的 definition 一词嫁接到本题 D) ✓ 正确 find a cause you can support with your time and talent ↔ Devote themselves to a worthy cause. 原文给的两个建议中，选项命中第二个 find a cause you can support with your time and talent——Devote themselves to a worthy cause. 是它的精准凝练

items.title: 2021年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
items.paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.passage:
P1 Can you remember what you ate yesterday? If asked, most people will be able to give a vague description of their main meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner. But can you be sure you've noted every snack bar in your car, or every handful of nuts at your desk? Most people will have a feeling that they've missed something out.

P2 We originally had this suspicion back in 2016, puzzled by the fact that national statistics showed calorie consumption falling dramatically over past decades. We found reliable evidence that people were drastically under-reporting what they ate.

P3 Now the Office for National Statistics has confirmed that we are consuming 50% more calories than our national statistics claim.

P4 Why is this happening? We can point to at least three potential causes. One is the rise in obesity levels itself. Under-reporting rates are much higher for obese people, because they simply consume more food, and thus have more to remember.

P5 Another cause is that the proportion of people who are trying to lose weight has been increasing over time. People who want to lose weight are more likely to under-report their eating—regardless of whether they are overweight or not. This may be driven partly by self-deception or "wishful thinking".

P6 The final potential cause is an increase in snacking and eating out over recent decades—both in terms of how often they happen and how much they contribute to our overall energy intake. Again, there is evidence that food consumed out of the home is one of the most poorly recorded categories in surveys.

P7 So, what's the message conveyed? For statistics, we should invest in more accurate measurement options. For policy, we need to focus on options that make it easy for people to eat fewer calories. If people do not know how much they are eating, it can be really hard for them to stick to a diet. Also, we should be looking for new ways to ensure what people eat wouldn't have much impact on their waistlines. If this works, it won't matter if they can't remember what they ate yesterday.

questions.q: What did the author suspect back in 2016?
options: Calorie consumption had fallen drastically over the decades.
Most people surveyed were reluctant to reveal what they ate.
The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption.
Most people did not include snacks when reporting their calorie intake.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did the author suspect back in 2016 问的是一个具体过去时间点上的具体事实，没 有 infer/imply 之类信号词，属于事实细节题。 51. What did the author suspect back in 2016? A) Calorie consumption had fallen drastically over the decades. B) Most people surveyed were reluctant to reveal what they ate. C) The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption. D) Most people did not include snacks when reporting their calorie intake.

【拆句】题干 What did the author suspect back in 2016? 是一个简单的特殊疑问句，主语 the author，谓语 suspect，宾语用 what 提问，back in 2016 是时间状语，结构平铺直叙，无 陷阱。

【定位】We originally had this suspicion back in 2016, puzzled by the fact that national statistics showed calorie consumption falling dramatically over past decades. 我们最初是在 2016 年产生这种怀疑的——我们困惑于一个事实：国家统计数据显示，过去 几十年里热量消费在大幅下降。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 Calorie consumption had fallen drastically over the decades. 复述的是统计数据本 身的表象，作者恰恰是怀疑这个表象不可信，而非相信它。 B) 无中生有 原文只说人们 drastically under-reporting——漏报，没有任何文字表明他们 reluctant to reveal——主观上不愿透露；后文第 5 段更解释为自我欺骗或愿景式思维，而非拒绝 回答。 C) ✓ 正确 national statistics showed calorie consumption falling dramatically over past decades ↔ The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption. 预判落点是“统计与现实不符”，四个选项里只有 The national statistics did not reflect the actual calorie consumption. 直接说统计没有反映真实情况，与预判完全吻合。 D) 张冠李戴 Most people did not include snacks when reporting their calorie intake. 接近第 1 段 every snack bar in your car 和第 6 段 snacking 的内容，但那些不是 2016 年的怀 疑，而是后续展开的具体机制。 国家统计局证实了什么? A) 人们的卡路里摄入量远未被准确报告。 B) 遗漏正餐导致了吃零食的习惯。 C) 国家的肥胖水平与卡路里摄入量有很大关系。 D) 卡路里摄入量与一个人吃零食的量有关。

questions.q: What has the Office for National Statistics verified?
options: People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported.
The missing out of main meals leads to the habit of snacking.
The nation's obesity level has much to do with calorie intake.
Calorie consumption is linked to the amount of snacks one eats.
questions.explain:
【判型】What has the Office for National Statistics verified? 直问某机构核实了什么事实，无推 断信号词，属事实细节题。

【拆句】题干 What has the Office for National Statistics verified? 是现在完成时的特殊疑问句， 主语是机构名，谓语 verified，结构清晰，无障碍。 52. What has the Office for National Statistics verified? A) People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported. B) The missing out of main meals leads to the habit of snacking. C) The nation's obesity level has much to do with calorie intake. D) Calorie consumption is linked to the amount of snacks one eats.

【定位】Now the Office for National Statistics has confirmed that we are consuming 50% more calories than our national statistics claim. 如今国家统计局已证实：我们实际摄入的热量比国家统计声称的高出 50%。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 we are consuming 50% more calories than our national statistics claim ↔ People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported. People's calorie intake was far from accurately reported. 把“实际比上报高出 50%” 这件事精确概括为“摄入量远未被准确上报”，与预判一一对应。 B) 无中生有 The missing out of main meals leads to the habit of snacking. 把“漏掉正餐”和“养成 吃零食的习惯”绑成因果，原文从未提及这种因果链——文中说的是“忘记零食”而非“漏掉 正餐导致吃零食”。 C) 张冠李戴 The nation's obesity level has much to do with calorie intake. 涉及肥胖与热量摄入 的关系，那是第 4 段 rise in obesity levels 后面的讨论，不是国家统计局证实的内容。 D) 张冠李戴 Calorie consumption is linked to the amount of snacks one eats. 类似第 6 段对零 食的讨论，但那是作者推论的“潜在原因之一”，不是国家统计局已证实的事实。 从文章中我们对肥胖者了解到什么? A) 他们通常对自己的饮食习惯保密。 B) 他们忽视了肥胖的潜在原因。 C) 他们情不自禁地吃得比应该吃的多。 D) 他们难以回忆起自己吃过什么。

questions.q: What do we learn about obese people from the passage?
options: They usually keep their eating habits a secret.
They overlook the potential causes of obesity.
They cannot help eating more than they should.
They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about obese people from the passage? 限定主体为某类人，问关于 他们的文本陈述，仍是文中明示的细节而非推断。

【拆句】题干 What do we learn about obese people from the passage? 是 What 引导的疑 问句，about obese people 限定 learn 的对象，from the passage 是出处状语，句意 直白。

【定位】Under-reporting rates are much higher for obese people, because they simply consume more food, and thus have more to remember. 肥胖人群的漏报率要高得多，因为他们吃得本来就多，需要回想的食物也就更多。 53. What do we learn about obese people from the passage? A) They usually keep their eating habits a secret. B) They overlook the potential causes of obesity. C) They cannot help eating more than they should. D) They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 They usually keep their eating habits a secret. 把客观上的漏报误读成主观上对外保 密，原文没有任何表示故意隐瞒的字眼。 B) 张冠李戴 They overlook the potential causes of obesity. 把“忽视肥胖原因”安到肥胖人群头 上，但全文中“指出潜在原因”的是作者（We can point to at least three potential causes），与肥胖人群无关。 C) 过度推断 They cannot help eating more than they should. 加入了 cannot help（情不自禁） 和 more than they should（超出应吃的量）两个主观限制，原文只是说 simply consume more food——“就是吃得多些”，并未涉及自控力或应有量。 D) ✓ 正确 they simply consume more food, and thus have more to remember ↔ They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten. 预判落在“记不清吃了什么”，四个选项中只有 They have difficulty recalling what they have eaten. 直接说回忆困难，与预判完美对应。 在食物消费调查中什么常常被忽视? A) 外出就餐的增长趋势。 B) 吃零食的潜在原因。 C) 人们的家庭能源消耗。 D) 人们多年来不断变化的饮食。

questions.q: What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption?
options: The growing trend of eating out.
The potential causes of snacking.
People's home energy consumption.
People's changing diet over the years.
questions.explain:
【判型】What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption? 问的是调查中常被漏掉 的某个具体类别，属于事实细节而非推断。

【拆句】题干 What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption? 主语 what，goes unnoticed 是系表结构（go + 形容词，表“处于…状态”），in surveys on food consumption 是地点状语限定情境，结构无陷阱，关键要识别 go unnoticed 的固定搭配 含义。

【定位】Again, there is evidence that food consumed out of the home is one of the most poorly recorded categories in surveys. 再者，有证据表明：在家以外吃的东西，是调查中被记得最差的类别之一。 54. What often goes unnoticed in surveys on food consumption? A) The growing trend of eating out. B) The potential causes of snacking. C) People's home energy consumption. D) People's changing diet over the years.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 food consumed out of the home ↔The growing trend of eating out. an increase in snacking and eating out over recent decades ↔ The growing trend of eating out. 段末明确说在家外吃饭是漏报最严重的类别之一，只有 The growing trend of eating out. 把“外出就餐”作为答案给出，与定位句完全对应。 B) 答非所问 题干问“调查中常被漏掉的是什么”，The potential causes of snacking. 谈的是“吃零食 的潜在原因”，方向跑偏；且原文也没说零食的“原因”被漏报。 C) 偷换概念 People's home energy consumption. 字面上像“家庭能源消费”，与“在家吃饭”完全是 两个领域；原文谈的是 energy intake（能量摄入），不是 energy consumption（能 源消费）。 D) 以偏概全 People's changing diet over the years. 用“饮食习惯随年份变化”这种大词把整篇主旨 偷换上来，原文段落讲的是某一类食物在调查中被漏报，不是泛泛“饮食变化”。 作者建议政策制定者就肥胖问题采取什么措施? A) 提醒人们减少吃零食。 B) 确保人们吃不增肥的食物。 C) 确保人们不会错过正餐。 D) 确保人们不坚持同样的饮食。

questions.q: What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity?
options: Remind people to cut down on snacking.
Make sure people eat non-fattening food.
Ensure people don't miss their main meals.
See that people don't stick to the same diet.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity? 问作者对决策者的具体 建议，文中尾段已明示，属细节题而非主旨题。

【拆句】题干 What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity? 是 What 引导的 疑问句，谓语 suggest 后接的是省略 that 的宾语从句 policymakers do ...，从句动词用原 形 do（suggest 类动词的虚拟语气），about obesity 限定建议主题。

【定位】Also, we should be looking for new ways to ensure what people eat wouldn't have much impact on their waistlines. 此外，我们应当寻找新方法，确保人们吃下去的东西不会对腰围产生多大影响。 55. What does the author suggest policymakers do about obesity? A) Remind people to cut down on snacking. B) Make sure people eat non-fattening food. C) Ensure people don't miss their main meals. D) See that people don't stick to the same diet.

【选项】A) 无中生有 Remind people to cut down on snacking. 让人们少吃零食，仅来自 snacking and eating out 的现象描述，文中并未在 P7 提出“提醒减少零食”这一具体政策建议。 B) ✓ 正确 what people eat wouldn\'t have much impact on their waistlines ↔ Make sure people eat non-fattening food. Make sure people eat non-fattening food. 把“吃了不会胖到腰围”换说成“吃不发胖的 食物”，是从定位句的反向角度切入同一件事——与预判正对。 C) 与原文相反 Ensure people don\'t miss their main meals. 让人们别漏掉正餐，与全文主旨方向相 反——文章说人们漏报、吃得多，不是吃得少，更不存在“应该多吃几顿正餐”的建议。 D) 偷换概念 See that people don\'t stick to the same diet. 让人们不要长期保持同一种饮食，原 文从未提及对单一饮食的看法；唯一相关的 stick to a diet 谈的是减肥者难以坚持节 食，与让大众放弃单一饮食毫无关系。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.passage:
P1 As many office workers adapt to remote work, cities may undergo fundamental change if offices remain under-utilized. Who will benefit if working from home becomes the norm?

P2 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work. However, these savings result from passing costs on to workers.

P3 Unless employees are fully compensated, this could become a variant of parasitic( 寄生的) capitalism, whereby corporate profits increasingly rely on extracting value from the public—and now personal—realm, rather than on generating new value.

P4 Though employers are backed by a chorus of remote work advocates, others note the loneliness, reduced productivity and inefficiencies of extended remote work.

P5 If working from home becomes permanent, employees will have to dedicate part of their private space to work. This requires purchasing desks, chairs and office equipment.

P6 It also means having private space dedicated to work: the space must be heated, cleaned, maintained and paid for. That depends on many things, but for purposes of illustration, I have run some estimates for Montreal. The exercise is simple but important, since it brings these costs out of the realm of speculation into the realm of meaningful discussion.

P7 Rough calculations show that the savings made by employers when their staff works from home are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive for setting up offices at home.

P8 What does this mean for offices in cities? One of two things may happen: Employers pass these costs onto employees. This would be a form of expropriation( 侵占), with employees absorbing production costs that have traditionally been paid by the employer. This represents a considerable transfer of value from employees to employers.

P9 When employees are properly compensated, employers' real estate savings will be modest. If savings are modest, then the many advantages of working in offices—such as lively atmosphere, rapidity of communication, team-building and acclimatization( 适应环境) of new employees—will encourage employers to shelve the idea of remote work and, like Yahoo in 2013, encourage employees to work most of the time from corporate office space.

questions.q: What does the author say about working from home?
options: It will become the norm sooner or later.
It requires employees to adapt promptly.
It benefits employers at the expense of employees.
It will force cities to transform their infrastructure.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about working from home? 没有 infer/imply/mainly about，而是问作者就 working from home 这一具体话题说了什么，落点在一处可定位的 判断句，因此按细节题处理。

【拆句】题干 What does the author say about working from home? 主干是 What does the author say，about working from home 是 say 的介词宾语状语，无从句、无否定、无比 较，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work. However, these savings result from passing costs on to workers. 雇主声称：员工从办公室转向居家办公时，他们能在地产上省下相当一笔。然而，这些节省 其实来自把成本转嫁给员工。

【选项】A) 把假设说成必然 It will become the norm sooner or later. 把 if working from home becomes the norm 的假设条件硬改成确定预测，作者只是在假设语境下讨论后果，并未断言它必将 成为常态。 B) 无中生有 It requires employees to adapt promptly. 中的 require 与 promptly 在文中无任何对 应；首段虽提 office workers adapt to remote work，但并未提出“要求迅速适应”的规 定性命题。 C) ✓ 正确 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate ↔It benefits employers these savings result from passing costs on to workers ↔at the expense of employees 预判到的“雇主受益、员工承担”两段恰好被 It benefits employers at the expense of employees. 同时覆盖，是定位句两部分的同义合并。 D) 过度推断 It will force cities to transform their infrastructure. 中的 force 与 transform their infrastructure 远超原文 cities may undergo fundamental change 的措辞——文中只 是说城市可能发生根本性变化，并未具体到基建改造，更未说“被迫”。 为什么有些人反对在家办公? A) 它削弱团队精神。 B) 它侵犯员工隐私。 C) 它破坏传统价值观。 D) 它对生产力产生负面影响。

questions.q: Why do some people oppose working from home?
options: It discourages team spirit.
It invades employees' privacy.
It undermines traditional values.
It negatively impacts productivity.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why do some people oppose working from home? 用 why 直接问反对原因，答案是文 中明确列举的事实理由，可在一句话里找到，按细节题处理。 47. Why do some people oppose working from home? A) It discourages team spirit. B) It invades employees' privacy. C) It undermines traditional values. D) It negatively impacts productivity.

【拆句】题干 Why do some people oppose working from home? 是标准 why 引导的疑问句， working from home 是 oppose 的动名词宾语，结构清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】Though employers are backed by a chorus of remote work advocates, others note the loneliness, reduced productivity and inefficiencies of extended remote work. 尽管雇主有一群远程办公拥护者助阵，也有人指出长期远程办公带来的孤独感、生产力下降 和低效问题。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 It discourages team spirit. 与 team-building 有形近，但 team-building 出现在尾段 讲办公室优势的语境里，并非反对方的理由；原文反对方提的是 loneliness 而不是 team spirit。 B) 无中生有 It invades employees' privacy. 中的 invades privacy 在文中无对应；dedicate part of their private space to work 只是说要在私人空间里腾地方，并非侵犯隐私。 C) 偷换概念 It undermines traditional values. 中的 traditional values 在原文完全没出现； traditionally been paid by the employer 里的 traditionally 是说“历来由雇主支付”， 跟“传统价值观”风马牛不相及。 D) ✓ 正确 reduced productivity ↔negatively impacts productivity 并列三项里 reduced productivity 与 negatively impacts productivity productivity 一词原词复现，且 reduced 与 negatively impacts 极性一致，是最干净的同义替换。 作者为什么对Montreal进行估算? A) 为严肃讨论提供有说服力的数据。 B) 说明工作模式正在发生的变化。 C) 展示远程办公对生产力的影响。 D) 举例说明远程办公如何影响经济。

questions.q: Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal?
options: To provide convincing data for serious discussion.
To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns.
To show the impact of remote working on productivity.
To exemplify how remote working affects the economy.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? 问的是作者具体动作的目的，原文 一般在动作句的同一句或紧邻句用 since/so as to/in order to 直接给出，按细节题处理。

【拆句】题干 Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? 是 why 引导的一般疑问句过 去时，for Montreal 作 estimates 的修饰短语，结构简单，无陷阱。 48. Why did the author run the estimates for Montreal? A) To provide convincing data for serious discussion. B) To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns. C) To show the impact of remote working on productivity. D) To exemplify how remote working affects the economy.

【定位】The exercise is simple but important, since it brings these costs out of the realm of speculation into the realm of meaningful discussion. 这项估算操作虽简单却重要，因为它把这些成本从空想范畴推进到可作有意义讨论的范畴。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 brings these costs out of the realm of speculation ↔convincing data into the realm of meaningful discussion ↔serious discussion 选项 To provide convincing data for serious discussion. 把 since 子句的两段（出空 想→入严肃讨论）逐一对应，是最干净的同义替换。 B) 答非所问 To illustrate the ongoing change in working patterns. 中的 change in working patterns 在原文是话题背景，不是作者做估算的目的；since 子句里完全没有这一 含义。 C) 张冠李戴 To show the impact of remote working on productivity. 把 reduced productivity 的子话题硬装成估算目的；蒙特利尔估算估的是成本，不是生产力。 D) 过度推断 To exemplify how remote working affects the economy. 把作者只为蒙特利尔一城做 的成本估算拔高为“对经济的影响”，原文 since 子句只说要推进 meaningful discussion，没有提 the economy。 我们能从作者的计算中得出什么结论? A) 将办公室工作转为在家办公毫无意义。 B) 员工从远程办公中获得的好处与雇主一样多。 C) 雇主从远程办公中获得的收益应作为补偿给予员工。 D) 应采取有效措施激励员工在家设立办公场所。

questions.q: What can we conclude from the author's calculations?
options: There is no point in transferring office work to working from home.
Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers.
Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation.
Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home.
questions.explain:
【判型】What can we conclude from the author's calculations? 用 conclude，要求由文内信息 推出一个未直接写出的结论，但只能一步延伸，属于轻推断题。

【拆句】题干 What can we conclude from the author's calculations? 是 wh-疑问句，from the author's calculations 是 conclude 的来源状语，结构简单，无陷阱。 49. What can we conclude from the author's calculations? A) There is no point in transferring office work to working from home. B) Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers. C) Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation. D) Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home.

【定位】Rough calculations show that the savings made by employers when their staff works from home are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive for setting up offices at home. 粗略计算表明，员工居家办公时雇主所节省的费用，与员工为在家设立办公空间应得的补偿 金额相当。

【选项】A) 过度推断 There is no point in transferring office work to working from home. 用 no point in 全盘否定居家办公，原文只说省额会被补偿抵消，并未说居家办公毫无意义；这是把 作者的有限主张推过头。 B) 偷换概念 Employees can benefit as much from remote working as their employers. 中的 as much as 等同关系在原文无对应；原文是说雇主省的需要全数补偿员工，并未推出员工 获得等额收益。 C) ✓ 正确 the savings made by employers ↔Employers' gain from remote working are of similar value to the compensation workers should receive ↔ should go to employees as compensation 预判到的“雇主省的≈员工该被补的→所以这笔钱应转给员工”恰好被 Employers' gain from remote working should go to employees as compensation. 完整覆盖，是教 科书式的一步推断。 D) 与原文相反 Effective measures should be taken to motivate employees to set up offices at home. 中的 motivate 是规定性命题，原文从未提出任何鼓励员工建家庭办公室的政策 建议；恰恰相反，作者偏向回办公室。 作者对在家办公的看法是什么? A) 如果可能应该避免。 B) 它只是一种临时措施。 C) 它可以降低公司的房地产成本。 D) 它可能影响员工的企业忠诚度。

questions.q: What is the author's opinion on working from home?
options: It should be avoided if possible.
It is only a temporary measure.
It can reduce companies' real estate costs.
It may affect employees' corporate loyalty.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the author's opinion on working from home? 直接用 opinion 询问作者态度， 需要聚合全文极性词，按态度题特殊路径处理。 50. What is the author's opinion on working from home? A) It should be avoided if possible. B) It is only a temporary measure. C) It can reduce companies' real estate costs. D) It may affect employees' corporate loyalty.

【拆句】题干 What is the author's opinion on working from home? 主干是 What is the author's opinion，on working from home 修饰 opinion，限定话题范围，结构简单，无 陷阱。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 shelve the idea of remote work ↔It should be avoided if possible. parasitic(寄生的) capitalism ↔should be avoided 全文从 parasitic→expropriation→shelve 一路负向收束，无一处肯定，It should be avoided if possible. 是唯一与主线全篇极性一致的选项。 B) 无中生有 It is only a temporary measure. 中的 temporary 在原文没有任何对应词；作者讨论的 是若成为常态会怎样，并未把它定性为“临时措施”。 C) 张冠李戴 It can reduce companies' real estate costs. 是雇主的说法 Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate，但作者随即反驳并在尾段说 employers' real estate savings will be modest——所以这不是作者的观点。 D) 无中生有 It may affect employees' corporate loyalty. 中的 corporate loyalty 在文中完全没出 现，作者关心的是成本转嫁与办公室优势，不涉及忠诚度问题。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.passage:
P1 The human thirst for knowledge is the driving force behind our successful development as a species. But curiosity can also be dangerous, leading to setbacks or even downfalls. Given curiosity's complexity, scientists have found it hard to define.

P2 While pinning down a definition has proven tricky, the general consensus is it's some means of information gathering. Psychologists also agree curiosity is intrinsically(内在地) motivated.

P3 Curiosity covers such a large set of behaviors that there probably isn't any single "curiosity gene" that makes humans wonder about and explore their environment. That said, curiosity does have a genetic component. Genes and the environment interact in many complex ways to shape individuals and guide their behavior, including their curiosity.

P4 Regardless of their genetic makeup, infants have to learn an incredible amount of information in a short time, and curiosity is one of the tools humans have found to accomplish that gigantic task.

P5 Hundreds of studies show that infants prefer novelty. It's what motivates non-human animals, human infants and probably human adults to explore and seek out new things before growing less interested in them after continued exposure.

P6 In some situations, the stakes are low and failure is a healthy part of growth. For instance, many babies are perfectly proficient crawlers, but they decide to try walking because there's more to see and do when they stand upright. But this milestone comes at a small cost. A study of 12- to 19-month-olds learning how to walk documented that these children fell down a lot. Seventeen times per hour, to be exact. But walking is faster than crawling, so this motivates expert crawlers to transition to walking.

P7 Sometimes, however, testing out a new idea can lead to disaster. For instance, the Inuit people of the Arctic regions have created incredible modes to deal with the challenges of living in northern climates, but what we forget about are the tens of thousands of people that tried and failed to make it in those challenging landscapes.

questions.q: What does the author say about curiosity?
options: It is too complex for non-scientists to understand.
It is the force that pushes human society forward.
It is a unique trait specific to the human race.
It is often the major cause for human failures.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say about curiosity? 询问作者明确陈述的内容，而非暗含意 思或主旨概括，属于针对原文具体表述的细节题。

【拆句】题干 What does the author say about curiosity? 是简单特殊疑问句，主干 the author say 接 about curiosity 介词短语作状语，无从句、无否定、无比较，结构平铺直叙、无 陷阱。

【定位】The human thirst for knowledge is the driving force behind our successful development as a species. 人类对知识的渴求是我们作为一个物种成功发展背后的驱动力。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文 scientists have found it hard to define 只说科学家觉得它难定义，并未说非科学 家无法理解；too complex for non-scientists to understand 把对象从“科学家”悄悄换 成“非科学家”、把“难定义”夸大为“无法理解”。 B) ✓ 正确 the driving force behind our successful development as a species ↔ the force that pushes human society forward our successful development as a species ↔human society 预判“好奇心推动人类整体发展”与 It is the force that pushes human society forward 在语义上完全重合，是定位句最干净的同义替换。 C) 无中生有 原文从未说好奇心是“人类专有的特征”，P5 反而提到 non-human animals 也会探索新 事物，a unique trait specific to the human race 与原文相反，属无中生有兼与原文 相反。 D) 过度推断 原文 curiosity can also be dangerous, leading to setbacks or even downfalls 用 also 引出次要补充，often the major cause for human failures 把 setbacks/downfalls 升级为 the major cause，并加上频率词 often，过度推断。 人们对好奇心的普遍理解是什么? A) 它激励人们寻求信息。 B) 它注定会改变人类基因。 C) 它给人们带来的好处多于坏处。 D) 它是所有人类行为的基础。

questions.q: What is the general understanding of curiosity?
options: It motivates people to seek information.
It is destined to transform human genes.
It does people more good than harm.
It underlies all human behaviors.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What is the general understanding of curiosity? 只问大家的共识内容是什么，属于 客观信息检索类细节题。

【拆句】题干 What is the general understanding of curiosity? 是“What is 主语？”句型，主语 the general understanding of curiosity 是名词词组，of 短语作后置定语限定 understanding，无陷阱。

【定位】While pinning down a definition has proven tricky, the general consensus is it's some means of information gathering. 尽管要给出确切定义被证明很棘手，普遍共识是好奇心是某种信息收集的手段。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 some means of information gathering ↔motivates people to seek information 预判“好奇心是信息收集的手段”与 It motivates people to seek information 在功能上 等价：好奇心驱动人去寻找/收集信息。 B) 无中生有 原文 curiosity does have a genetic component 只说好奇心有遗传成分，并未说好奇 心“注定要改变人类基因”；destined to transform human genes 不仅方向反转，还把 名词性的“遗传成分”改成动词性的“改造基因”，完全无据。 C) 无中生有 原文 can also be dangerous 与 But curiosity often comes with a cost 都明示了好奇 心的代价，并未给出 “好处大于坏处” 的比较结论；does people more good than harm 凭空加上比较结构。 D) 以偏概全 原文 some means of information gathering 只说好奇心是信息收集的“某种”手段， underlies all human behaviors 把范围夸大到“支配全部人类行为”，远超原文范围。 关于基因如何塑造人们的行为,我们了解到什么? A) 它们决定人们的思维方式。 B) 它们解释了学习中的年龄差异。 C) 它们使人们能够承担重大任务。 D) 它们与环境共同起作用。

questions.q: What do we learn about how genes shape people's behavior?
options: They determine people's way of thinking.
They account for age differences in learning.
They enable people to undertake massive tasks.
They work in conjunction with the environment.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn about how genes shape people's behavior? 问的是文中明示的 机理而非推断，属细节题。 53. What do we learn about how genes shape people's behavior? A) They determine people's way of thinking. B) They account for age differences in learning. C) They enable people to undertake massive tasks. D) They work in conjunction with the environment.

【拆句】题干 What do we learn about how genes shape people's behavior? 主干是 What do we learn about，about 后跟 how 引导的宾语从句 how genes shape people's behavior ——how 在此是“以何种方式”，不是“是否”，提问点落在“机理”而不是“结果存在与否”。

【定位】Genes and the environment interact in many complex ways to shape individuals and guide their behavior, including their curiosity. 基因和环境以许多复杂的方式相互作用，塑造个体并指导他们的行为，包括他们的好奇心。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文谈的是 behavior（行为），选项 way of thinking 偷换为思维方式；且 determine 的力度比 shape and guide 强，原文也强调“与环境互动”，并非基因单方“决定”。 B) 无中生有 原文没有讨论学习中的年龄差异，age differences in learning 完全是凭空添加的 话题。 C) 张冠李戴 原文 infants have to learn an incredible amount of information in a short time 描 述的是婴儿任务量大，并未说基因让人“承担巨大任务”；enable people to undertake massive tasks 把对象张冠李戴。 D) ✓ 正确 Genes and the environment interact in many complex ways ↔ They work in conjunction with the environment shape individuals and guide their behavior ↔work 预判“基因与环境共同起作用”与 They work in conjunction with the environment 在 主语、对象、动作方向上一一对应。 大量研究表明婴儿有什么特点? A) 他们比成年人好奇心强得多。 B) 他们更喜欢追逐所有新奇的事物。 C) 他们的兴趣与成年人不同。 D) 他们表现出非人类动物的行为。

questions.q: What do numerous studies show about infants?
options: They are far more curious than adults.
They prefer to go after all that is novel.
They have different interests than adults.
They show non-human animal behaviors.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do numerous studies show about infants? 问研究“表明了什么”，是对原文研 究结论的直接询问，属细节题。

【拆句】题干 What do numerous studies show about infants? 是“What do A show about B?” 句型，主语 numerous studies、宾语为 What、关于 infants，提问点是“关于婴儿的研究 结论”，无陷阱。 54. What do numerous studies show about infants? A) They are far more curious than adults. B) They prefer to go after all that is novel. C) They have different interests than adults. D) They show non-human animal behaviors.

【定位】Hundreds of studies show that infants prefer novelty. 数以百计的研究表明，婴儿偏爱新奇事物。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文没有对婴儿与成人做“好奇程度比较”，只在末尾说 probably human adults 也会探 索；far more curious than adults 凭空加上比较级 + 程度副词 far more。 B) ✓ 正确 infants prefer novelty ↔They prefer to go after all that is novel 预判“婴儿偏爱新奇事物”与 They prefer to go after all that is novel 几乎逐字对应，是 定位句最干净的同义替换。 C) 偷换概念 原文只说婴儿偏好新奇事物，并没有比较婴儿与成人的兴趣范围；different interests than adults 偷换为“兴趣点的差异”，与原文研究结论不在一个维度。 D) 偷换概念 原文 non-human animals, human infants and probably human adults 把动物、婴 儿、成人并列为同样会“偏好新奇”的群体，并非说婴儿“表现出非人类动物的行为”； show non-human animal behaviors 把并列关系曲解为附属关系。 北极地区因纽特人的例子说明了什么? A) 人类探索好奇心的代价。 B) 寒冷天气令人难以置信的严酷。 C) 源于好奇心的创新想法。 D) 从过去失败中学习的重要性。

questions.q: What does the example of the Inuit people of the Arctic regions illustrate?
options: The cost of humans' curiosity to explore.
The incredible harshness of cold weather.
The innovative ideas stemming from curiosity.
The importance of learning from past failures.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the example of the Inuit people of the Arctic regions illustrate? 明确 把 the Inuit people 标记为 the example，问其“说明了什么”，是典型的例证目的题。

【拆句】题干 What does the example of the Inuit people of the Arctic regions illustrate? 主干 the example illustrate，其中 of the Inuit people of the Arctic regions 嵌套两层 of 短语 作 example 的后置定语；考生易把宾语错认为“因纽特人本身”，实际宾语是 What，即“这 个例子说明了什么”。

【定位】But curiosity often comes with a cost. 但好奇心往往是有代价的。 55. What does the example of the Inuit people of the Arctic regions illustrate? A) The cost of humans' curiosity to explore. B) The incredible harshness of cold weather. C) The innovative ideas stemming from curiosity. D) The importance of learning from past failures.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 But curiosity often comes with a cost ↔The cost of humans' curiosity to explore tens of thousands of people that tried and failed ↔to explore 预判“好奇心要付出代价”与 The cost of humans' curiosity to explore 在“代价 + 好奇 心 + 探索”三要素上完全对应。 B) 答非所问 The incredible harshness of cold weather 只是 living in northern climates 的背景 描述，是例子里的细节，而非例子要支撑的论点；例证目的题不能选例子内部的表层 细节。 C) 以偏概全 原文 created incredible modes to deal with the challenges 与 tens of thousands of people that tried and failed 是一组对比，选项 innovative ideas stemming from curiosity 只看到前者“创新成果”，忽略后者“代价”——而后者才是本段真正想强调的部 分（由 but what we forget about 引出）。 D) 偷换概念 原文 But curiosity often comes with a cost 与 tens of thousands of people that tried and failed 只强调“代价/牺牲”这一客观事实，没有谈“从过往失败中学习”的主观行 动；learning from past failures 把客观代价偷换为主观学习行为。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.passage:
P1 With obesity now affecting 29% of the population in England, and expected to rise to 35% by 2030, should we now recognise it as a disease? Obesity, in which excess body fat has accumulated to such an extent that health may be adversely affected, meets the dictionary definition of disease, argues Professor John Wilding. He points out that more than 200 genes influence weight. "Thus body weight is strongly influenced by biology—it is not an individual's fault if they develop obesity." Yet the widespread view is that obesity is self-induced and that it is entirely the individual's responsibility to do something about it. Recognising obesity as a chronic disease with severe complications rather than a lifestyle choice "should help reduce the stigma(耻辱) and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity," he adds.

P2 Professor Wilding disagrees that labelling a high proportion of the population as having a disease removes personal responsibility or may overwhelm health services, pointing out that other common diseases, such as high blood pressure and diabetes, require people to take action to manage their condition. He suggests that most people with obesity will eventually develop complications. "But unless we accept that obesity is a disease, we are not going to be able to tackle it," he concludes.

P3 But Dr. Richard Pile, a physician with a special interest in diabetes, argues that adopting this approach "could actually result in worse outcomes for individuals and society." He believes that the dictionary definition of disease "is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease" and says the question is not whether we can, but whether we should, and to what end.

P4 If labelling obesity as a disease was harmless then it wouldn't really matter, he writes. But labelling obesity as a disease "risks reducing autonomy, disempowering and robbing people of the intrinsic(内在的) motivation that is such an important enabler of change." What's more, making obesity a disease "may not benefit patients, but it will benefit healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical(制药的) industry when health insurance and clinical guidelines promote treatment with drugs and surgery," he warns.

questions.q: What does Professor John Wilding argue about obesity?
options: Its impact on society is expected to rise.
It is now too widespread to be neglected.
It should be regarded as a genetic disease.
Its dictionary definition should be updated.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Professor John Wilding argue about obesity? 问的是这位教授关于肥胖的** 主张**，答案要在原文的明确表述中找，不需要跨段综合，是典型的细节题。

【拆句】题干 What does Professor John Wilding argue about obesity? 是标准的 what + 主语 + 动词 + 介词短语 结构，主语「Professor John Wilding」，谓语「argue」，「about obesity」是 argue 的话题状语；句子平铺直叙，无陷阱。 46. What does Professor John Wilding argue about obesity? A) Its impact on society is expected to rise. B) It is now too widespread to be neglected. C) It should be regarded as a genetic disease. D) Its dictionary definition should be updated.

【定位】He points out that more than 200 genes influence weight. "Thus body weight is strongly influenced by biology—it is not an individual's fault if they develop obesity." 他指出有超过 200 个基因影响体重。「因此体重受生物学因素强烈影响——一个人如果得 了肥胖症，并不是他自己的过错。」

【选项】A) 张冠李戴：把背景数据安到具名人物头上 Its impact on society is expected to rise. 实际上是文章开头那句 obesity now affecting 29% of the population in England, and expected to rise to 35% by 2030 的概括，是作者交代的背景数据，并非 Wilding 教授「argue about obesity」的 主张。 B) 无中生有：常识合理但原文未支撑 It is now too widespread to be neglected. 是个看似合理的概括，但 Wilding 全文论 证的是「肥胖应被视为疾病」「不是个人过错」，从未以「太普遍以至于无法忽视」为 论点；原文虽提到 29%/35% 的数据，但落点是「该不该承认为疾病」，与「too widespread to be neglected」不构成等值。 C) ✓ 正确 more than 200 genes influence weight ↔a genetic disease not an individual's fault if they develop obesity ↔regarded as a genetic disease 预判抓住「肥胖与基因强相关 + 应作为疾病看待」两个要点，It should be regarded as a genetic disease. 恰好同时覆盖这两点，与 Wilding 在 P1 的主张完全对齐。 D) 偷换概念：动词替换改变命题 Its dictionary definition should be updated. 偷换了原文的「meets the dictionary definition」——Wilding 是说「肥胖**符合**字典关于 disease 的定义」，主张承认它 **是**疾病，不是主张**更新**字典定义；选项把「符合定义」偷换成「更新定义」。 大众对肥胖症的看法是什么? A) 它难以定义。 B) 它是一种现代疾病。 C) 它与基因有很大关系。 D) 它源于缺乏自我控制。

questions.q: What is the popular view of obesity?
options: It is difficult to define.
It is a modern disease.
It has much to do with one's genes.
It results from a lack of self-control.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the popular view of obesity? 问的是「大众对肥胖的看法是什么」，要找的是原 文中对大众观点的客观陈述，属于细节题。

【拆句】题干 What is the popular view of obesity? 是简单的 what is + 名词短语 结构，「of obesity」是 popular view 的修饰，限定看法的对象；结构简单，无陷阱。 47. What is the popular view of obesity? A) It is difficult to define. B) It is a modern disease. C) It has much to do with one's genes. D) It results from a lack of self-control.

【定位】Yet the widespread view is that obesity is self-induced and that it is entirely the individual's responsibility to do something about it. 然而，普遍的观点认为，肥胖是自找的，并且完全是个人自己的责任去采取行动加以解决。

【选项】A) 无中生有：抓住选项与原文方向相反的反例 It is difficult to define. 关于「肥胖难以定义」的说法在原文找不到任何依据；原文 P1 明确给出了肥胖的定义（excess body fat …），反而是「易定义」的方向，与本选项 相反。 B) 答非所问：与题干所问对象不对齐 It is a modern disease. 想说「肥胖是一种现代疾病」，但原文 the widespread view 描述的大众观点是「自找的、个人责任」，从未把大众观点概括为「现代疾病」；而且 大众观点恰恰是「不视为疾病」，与「modern disease」方向冲突。 C) 张冠李戴：用对立方观点冒充本方观点 It has much to do with one's genes. 实际上是 Wilding 教授的主张（more than 200 genes influence weight），而非大众观点；原文用 Yet 把大众观点与 Wilding 主张明 确切开——大众恰好是不认基因这一论的。 D) ✓ 正确 obesity is self-induced ↔results from a lack of self-control it is entirely the individual's responsibility to do something about it ↔a lack of self-control 预判要点「自找的 + 自己负责」分别对应到 results from a lack of self-control 中的 「self-control」与「lack of」，D 是唯一同时覆盖这两点的选项。 为什么有些人反对将肥胖症归类为疾病? A) 肥胖者将不会感到有责任采取任何行动。 B) 肥胖者将无力承担医疗费用。 C) 肥胖者将被焦虑所淹没。 D) 肥胖者将受到歧视。

questions.q: Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease?
options: Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action.
Obese people would not be able to afford the medical costs.
Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety.
Obese people would be discriminated against.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease? 问的是反方反对的具 体原因，对应原文反方论据的明确陈述，属于细节题。

【拆句】题干 Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease? 主干是 why + be + 主语 + 过去分词作表语 (opposed to)，labelling … as a disease 是动名词短语作 to 的宾语；结构稍长但平铺直叙，无陷阱。 48. Why are some people opposed to labelling obesity as a disease? A) Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action. B) Obese people would not be able to afford the medical costs. C) Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety. D) Obese people would be discriminated against.

【定位】But labelling obesity as a disease "risks reducing autonomy, disempowering and robbing people of the intrinsic motivation that is such an important enabler of change." 但把肥胖定性为疾病「有可能削弱人的自主性，让人失去权能感，并夺走对改变如此重要的 内在动力。」

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 reducing autonomy, disempowering and robbing people of the intrinsic motivation ↔ not feel responsible to take any action other common diseases, such as high blood pressure and diabetes, require people to take action to manage their condition ↔to take any action 预判要点「失去自主与改变动力」在四个选项里只有 Obese people would not feel responsible to take any action. 能落地——「失去内在动力 + 失去自主」≈「不觉得 自己有责任行动」。 B) 无中生有：把次相关话题拉来当依据 Obese people would not be able to afford the medical costs. 关于「肥胖者支付不 起医疗费用」在原文找不到任何对应；原文末段提到的费用相关内容是 health insurance and clinical guidelines promote treatment with drugs and surgery，谈 的是谁受益（机构与药企），不是谁付不起。 C) 偷换概念：把动力问题偷换为情绪问题 Obese people would be overwhelmed with anxiety. 把原文「失去 intrinsic motivation」（失去改变的内在动力）偷换为「被焦虑压垮」（情绪问题）——前者关 乎主体动力是否减弱，后者关乎情绪是否上升，方向不一致。 D) 张冠李戴：把正方支持理由当反方反对理由 Obese people would be discriminated against. 实际上是 Wilding 在 should help reduce the stigma and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity 提到的——把肥胖视为疾病可以**减少**歧视，是 Wilding 支持贴标签的理由；本题问 的是**反对**贴标签的理由，正反阵营完全相反。 Richard Pile 博士如何看待词典中关于疾病的定义? A) 它对理解肥胖症毫无用处。 B) 它过于宽泛因而缺乏明确性。 C) 它对解决患者的问题帮助甚微。 D) 它对关于肥胖症的争论影响甚微。

questions.q: What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease?
options: It is of no use in understanding obesity.
It is too inclusive and thus lacks clarity.
It helps little to solve patients' problems.
It matters little to the debate over obesity.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 问的是具名人 物对一个具体概念的看法，原文中有他直接的评价句，属于细节题。

【拆句】题干 What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 主干是 what + do/does + 主语 + think of + 宾语，think of 是固定搭配「对……的看法」；结构 常规，无陷阱。

【定位】He believes that the dictionary definition of disease "is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease" and says the question is not whether we can, but whether we should, and to what end. 他认为，对 disease 一词的字典定义「过于含糊，以至于我们几乎可以把任何东西都归入疾 病」，并说问题不在于「我们能不能」，而在于「我们该不该，以及目的何在」。

【选项】A) 过度推断：把局部批评放大成全盘否定 It is of no use in understanding obesity. 把 Pile 的「定义含糊」推得过远——他只 是说定义太宽泛而已，没说「字典定义对理解肥胖毫无用处」；恰恰相反，他的论证起 点正是「按字典定义看，肥胖确实可被归入 disease」（the question is not whether we can）。 B) ✓ 正确 is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease ↔ too inclusive and thus lacks clarity is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease ↔and thus 预判要点「过于含糊 + 范围过广」在选项里精准对位为 too inclusive and thus lacks clarity，是唯一覆盖两个语义点的选项。 C) 答非所问：偷偷把问域换到下一步 It helps little to solve patients' problems. 谈的是「字典定义对解决患者问题帮助不 大」，把焦点从「定义本身的特性」偏移到「定义对患者的影响」；题干 What does Dr. Richard Pile think of the dictionary definition of disease? 问的是 Pile 对**定义 本身**的看法。 D) 与原文相反：极性反转 It matters little to the debate over obesity. 说「字典定义对肥胖之争没什么关系」， 但 Pile 在 P3 整段都在围绕字典定义展开批评，并以此为立论起点（the dictionary definition of disease is so vague）；可见字典定义对他**至关重要**，与「matters little」语义相反。 Richard Pile 博士对将肥胖症归类为疾病有何担忧? A) 它可能影响肥胖者的生活质量。 B) 它可能加速肥胖症的蔓延。 C) 它可能导致医生短缺。 D) 它可能对患者没什么好处。

questions.q: What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease?
options: It may affect obese people's quality of life.
It may accelerate the spread of obesity.
It may cause a shortage of doctors.
It may do little good to patients.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease? 问的是 Pile 担忧的具体内容，原文末段有明确陈述，属于细节题。

【拆句】题干 What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease? 主干是 what + be + 主语，「about classifying obesity as a disease」是 concern 的修饰短 语，限定担忧的对象；结构清晰，无陷阱。

【定位】What's more, making obesity a disease "may not benefit patients, but it will benefit healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry when health insurance and clinical guidelines promote treatment with drugs and surgery," he warns. 此外，他警告说，把肥胖变成一种疾病「未必使患者受益，但当医保和临床指南推动用药物 和手术进行治疗时，它将让医疗机构和制药业受益」。 50. What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease? A) It may affect obese people's quality of life. B) It may accelerate the spread of obesity. C) It may cause a shortage of doctors. D) It may do little good to patients.

【选项】A) 无中生有：用合理却未现的概念顶替 It may affect obese people's quality of life. 关于「影响肥胖者生活质量」在原文找不 到对应表述；Pile 的担忧落在「医疗效用」和「自主与动力」上，不是「生活质量」这 个独立维度。 B) 与原文相反/混搭：把背景趋势伪装成反方担忧 It may accelerate the spread of obesity. 说贴疾病标签会「加速肥胖蔓延」，但原文 Pile 担忧的是「会让人失去改变动力」（robbing people of the intrinsic motivation）——这是「不利于改善」的间接后果，但与「加速蔓延」是两码事；而且 P1 中肥胖的扩张趋势是 Wilding 立场的背景数据，与 Pile 的担忧无关。 C) 无中生有：用相邻话题词凭空造命题 It may cause a shortage of doctors. 关于「导致医生短缺」在原文找不到任何依据； 原文末段提到 healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry 会受益，恰恰 是「医疗供给方得利」的方向，与「短缺」相反。 D) ✓ 正确 may not benefit patients ↔may do little good to patients may not benefit patients, but it will benefit healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry ↔do little good to patients 四个选项里只有 It may do little good to patients. 在主体（患者）与极性（益处不 大）两端都与 Pile 的核心担忧一致；其余选项要么换了担忧对象，要么改了担忧内容。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.passage:
P1 Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming. Research has found that having access to diverse teachers is beneficial for children. For the youngest learners, it means they are more likely to get exposed to different varieties of play and communication. It also helps them develop healthy ideas around gender.

P2 "In our world and our society, we have very specific stereotypes(模式化形象) of gender roles," said Mindi Reich-Shapiro, an assistant professor in the teacher education department of the Borough of Manhattan Community College, and one of the authors of a recent study. "It's important for children to see other possibilities and other paths they can take."

P3 Despite mostly feeling supported by colleagues and family members, many of the male educators surveyed in the study reported facing social or cultural resistance in their careers as early education teachers. Some also reported that there were parents surprised or concerned that their child had a male teacher. And they had been advised by colleagues or other staff not to hug children.

P4 Reich-Shapiro and fellow researchers made several recommendations to increase male representation in the field. Low pay has long been acknowledged as a major issue in the early childhood field. Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term. The report suggests paying all early childhood educators the way elementary school teachers are paid.

P5 Cities and programs should establish support groups for male early childhood educators and provide mentoring and professional development advice for male educators and their program leaders.

P6 The authors also suggest that traditional recruitment approaches for early childhood educators "do not address the gender gap in the field." They recommend providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs, targeting groups of men who are considering a career change, such as fathers.

questions.q: What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?
options: It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.
It exposes children to different ways of interaction.
It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers.
It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?是典型的「从某段我们了解到什么」句式，要的是段内已写明的客观信息，而非推断或 主旨。 51. What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.? A) It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles. B) It exposes children to different ways of interaction. C) It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers. D) It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.

【拆句】题干What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?是个特殊疑问句，主干是 What do we learn from the first paragraph，about early childhood education in the U.S. 是 learn 的话题补足，整体平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming. 全美范围内，幼教队伍中男性仅约百分之三。专家说这会对处于性别角色与身份认知快速形 成期的幼儿产生影响。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.说幼教「帮助提升」孩子的性别 角色意识，但原文只说男教师缺失「影响」孩子正在形成的性别角色认知，并未说幼教 在主动培养这种意识，把「被动塑造期」误读为「主动培养」。 B) 张冠李戴 It exposes children to different ways of interaction.说的是文中「师资多样性」才能 带来的好处，原文限定语是having access to diverse teachers，而题干问的是 early childhood education 整体——把条件子句的局部好处当成整体属性，是张冠李戴。 C) ✓ 正确 only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male ↔a lack of male teachers this can have an impact on young children ↔negatively impacted 预判是「男教师缺失带来负面影响」，It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers.正好把「缺失」与「负面影响」两块信息都点到了，是定位句的浓缩同义版。 D) 过度推断 It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.说幼教「明确以通过游戏塑造 孩子身份为目标」，原文只提到孩子的性别角色与身份处在「快速形成期」，并未说幼 教把这当成目标，且 through play 只是different varieties of play and communication里的一部分，被拿来当整体目标。 Mindi Reich-Shapiro在评论幼儿教育时强调了什么? A) 拓宽儿童视野的重要性。 B) 父亲对儿童成长的责任。 C) 创建教师教育项目的紧迫性。 D) 教师在激励儿童学习方面的作用。

questions.q: What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?
options: The importance of broadening children's horizons.
The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth.
The urgency of creating teacher education programs.
The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?问的是某具体人物在评论中强调的内容，答案就在她说的话里，不是全篇主旨。 52. What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education? A) The importance of broadening children's horizons. B) The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth. C) The urgency of creating teacher education programs. D) The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.

【拆句】题干What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?主干是 What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize，in her comment on childhood education 是状语限定语境，结构清晰、无陷阱。

【定位】It's important for children to see other possibilities and other paths they can take. 对孩子来说，看到其他可能性、看到他们可以走的其他道路，是很重要的。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 see other possibilities and other paths they can take ↔broadening children's horizons It's important for children ↔The importance of 预判强调「让孩子看到其他可能性」，The importance of broadening children's horizons.正是这句话的抽象浓缩，二者覆盖范围完全重合。 B) 张冠李戴 The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth.说的是父亲的责任，但 Reich- Shapiro 在P2里通篇没提父亲——把同一篇文章后段such as fathers里出现的「父亲」 嫁接到她头上，是张冠李戴。 C) 偷换概念 The urgency of creating teacher education programs.谈的是建立教师教育项目的紧 迫性，原文里 Reich-Shapiro 只是在the teacher education department任职，但她在 P2里强调的是孩子的认知拓展，而非项目建设——利用她的所属系名做诱饵。 D) 过度推断 The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.说的是教师在激励孩子学习中的 作用，但原文里 Reich-Shapiro 谈的是让孩子看到不同可能，根本没提到学习动机或激 励——把「看到可能」过度推断成「激励学习」。 从研究中男性教师的回应我们了解到什么? A) 他们中的一些人在拥抱儿童时感到尴尬。 B) 他们感到有压力要跟上女性同事的步伐。 C) 他们发现很难满足孩子家长的期望。 D) 他们中的许多人感到在社会和文化上受到偏见对待。

questions.q: What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?
options: Some of them find it awkward when hugging children.
They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues.
They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents.
Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?要的是受访 男教师在调查中说了什么，是研究汇报里的显性细节。

【拆句】题干What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?主干是 What do we learn about male teachers，from their responses in the study 是介词短 语状语限定信息来源，整句结构平直、无陷阱。 53. What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study? A) Some of them find it awkward when hugging children. B) They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues. C) They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents. D) Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.

【定位】Despite mostly feeling supported by colleagues and family members, many of the male educators surveyed in the study reported facing social or cultural resistance in their careers as early education teachers. 尽管大多数人觉得获得了同事与家人的支持，许多受访男幼教仍然反映在职业中遇到社会或 文化层面的阻力。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 Some of them find it awkward when hugging children.说的是男教师自己觉得拥抱 孩子尴尬；原文是they had been advised by colleagues or other staff not to hug children——是同事的建议，不是男教师本人的主观感受。 B) 无中生有 They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues.说他们感到要「追赶女同 事」的压力，但原文从未做男女教师之间的对照，更没说要 keep up with 女同事—— 属于无中生有。 C) 过度推断 They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents.说男教师「难以达到家 长期望」，但原文只说有些家长surprised or concerned孩子有男教师，并没说家长对 他们提出了某种「期望」，更没说他们「达不到」——是过度推断。 D) ✓ 正确 many of the male educators ↔Many of them facing social or cultural resistance ↔feel prejudiced against socially and culturally 预判直击「许多男教师感到社会文化层面的不接纳」，Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.在主体（many of them）、情感（feel prejudiced against）、范围（socially and culturally）三块都完全咬合。 男性投身幼儿教育需要什么? A) 更高的薪酬。 B) 工作保障。 C) 社会认可。 D) 更好的工作条件。

questions.q: What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?
options: Higher pay.
Job security.
Social recognition.
Better working conditions.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?问的是文章显性提到 的留任条件，答案是原文中具体写出的因素。

【拆句】题干What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?主干是 What is needed，for men to commit to early childhood education 是不定式短语作状语表「为 了…」，结构简单、无陷阱。 54. What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education? A) Higher pay. B) Job security. C) Social recognition. D) Better working conditions.

【定位】Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term. 在那些表示打算留在幼教队伍的男教师里，超过百分之七十的人指出涨薪是他们长期投身这 一职业的主要动因。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 an increased salary ↔Higher pay a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term ↔ What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education? 预判明确指向「涨薪」，Higher pay.就是这一信息最直接、最简洁的同义版本，没有附 加任何原文未明的内容。 B) 无中生有 Job security.说的是工作稳定性或保障，原文虽提到男教师「打算留下来」，但讲的是 个人意愿，并未把「工作保障」作为留下来所需的条件——属于无中生有。 C) 张冠李戴 Social recognition.谈的是社会层面的认可，原文里「社会文化阻力」出现于P3，而第 54题的定位段P4谈的是薪资动因——选项把第53题段的话题张冠李戴到第54题。 D) 以偏概全 Better working conditions.说的是更好的工作条件——它是更宽的概念，可能包括薪资 也可能不包括；但原文明确把动因点到「涨薪」，并未把笼统的「工作条件」列为动 因，选项以偏概全。 研究作者建议采取什么措施来缩小幼儿教育中的性别差距? A) 招募对幼儿教育有热情的年轻男性。 B) 采取措施吸引有意向的男性教师到该领域工作。 C) 说服准父亲们考虑改变他们的职业生涯。 D) 为男性教师提供更多晋升机会。

questions.q: What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?
options: Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children.
Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field.
Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career.
Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?问的是作者明文给出的建议，是显性细节而非主旨。

【拆句】题干What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?主干是 What do the authors of the study recommend，to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education 是不定式短语作状语表目的，结构 清晰、无陷阱。 55. What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education? A) Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children. B) Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field. C) Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career. D) Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.

【定位】They recommend providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs, targeting groups of men who are considering a career change, such as fathers. 他们建议通过培训与志愿项目，给年轻男性提供与儿童一起工作的机会，并把目光投向考虑 转行的男性群体，例如父亲们。

【选项】A) 无中生有 Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children.给目标人 群加上 a passion for educating young children 的条件，但原文只说面向 young men 与「考虑转行的男性」，并没限定他们要「有热情」——属于无中生有。 B) ✓ 正确 providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs ↔Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field groups of men who are considering a career change ↔prospective male teachers 预判强调「采取措施吸引潜在男性入行」，Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field.恰好把「动作（taking measures）+对象 （prospective male teachers）+目的（work in the field）」三块都覆盖到位。 C) 偷换概念 Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career.里 prospective fathers 指「准父亲」，但原文such as fathers指的是「已经是父亲的 人」，且原文是把父亲作为「考虑转行的男性」的一个例子，而非要去「说服准父亲转 行」——主体身份与动作方向都被偷换。 D) 与原文相反 Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.谈的是给已经 在岗的男教师更多晋升机会，但原文P6的建议是「吸引尚未入行的人入行」，并非「给 在岗的更多晋升」——动作对象（在岗 vs 未入行）与动作类型（晋升 vs 进入）都与原 文相反。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读1
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.passage:
P1 Have you ever wondered how acceptable it is to hug or touch someone? While it may sound safe to avoid all physical contact so as not to offend anyone, the lack of touching might imply cold attitudes or indifference in interpersonal relationships.

P2 So, what should we do? The simple answer is to thoroughly learn unique cultural norms for physical contact. In nonverbal communication terminology( 术语), physical contact and the study of touching are generally referred to as haptics.

P3 Haptics in communication often suggest the level of intimacy. They are usually classified into two groups: high-contact and low-contact.

P4 Asia and quite surprisingly the United States, Canada and Britain belong to low-contact cultures. People from the rest of the world, such as Latin America, are considered to be in high-contact cultures, where they tend to expect touching in social interactions and feel more comfortable with physical closeness. Despite the classification, there are more complex factors such as relational closeness, gender, age, and context that can affect how someone views physical contact.

P5 One common French custom of greetings is cheek-kissing, but it is mostly restricted to friends, close acquaintances and family members. While cheek-kissing for Latin Americans is also a universal greeting form, it does not require such a high degree of relational closeness. However, gender matters more for them because cheek-kissing often only happens between women or a man and a woman but not two men.

P6 In contrast, in certain Arabian, African, and Asian countries, men can publicly hold hands or show physical affection as signs of brotherhood or friendship while these behaviors may suggest a romantic relationship in other parts of the world. Although men's touching is more normal in these cultures, physical contact between persons of opposite sexes who are not family members is negatively perceived in Arabian countries.

P7 These factors could definitely affect the degree to which someone is comfortable with tactile(触觉的) communication and physical intimacy. Therefore, if you are someone who loves to show physical affection, you should not be afraid to show it or drastically change your behaviors—just ask for consent beforehand!

questions.q: What does the author say in the first paragraph about physical contact?
options: Its role in interpersonal relationships is getting increasingly important.
It is becoming more acceptable to many who used to think it offensive.
Its absence might suggest a lack of warmth in interpersonal relationships.
It might prompt different responses from people of different social backgrounds.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author say in the first paragraph about physical contact? 问"作者 在第一段就肢体接触说了什么"，是对原文具体陈述的客观转述，不需要推断或归纳全文。

【拆句】Q46 主干是 "What does the author say about physical contact"，中间插入的 in the first paragraph 是状语，限定作者发表此言论的位置；about physical contact 是 say 的 内容范围。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】While it may sound safe to avoid all physical contact so as not to offend anyone, the lack of touching might imply cold attitudes or indifference in interpersonal relationships. 尽管完全避免身体接触听起来很安全，可以不冒犯任何人，但缺乏触碰可能在人际关系中暗 示冷漠的态度或漠不关心。

【选项】A) 无中生有 选项 getting increasingly important 强调"重要性在上升"是动态趋势判断，但定位句 只说"不接触会显冷漠"，没有时间维度的变化。 B) 偷换概念 原文没说"原本认为接触冒犯的人现在更接受它了"——it 指代和 used to think 时态都 对不上原文。 C) ✓ 正确 the lack of touching ↔Its absence might imply cold attitudes or indifference in interpersonal relationships ↔ might suggest a lack of warmth in interpersonal relationships 选项 Its absence might suggest a lack of warmth in interpersonal relationships. 几 乎逐成分对应定位句：absence↔lack of touching，suggest↔imply，lack of warmth↔cold attitudes or indifference，与预判完全吻合。 D) 张冠李戴 原文第一段没有引入"社会背景"维度——"不同社会背景的人反应不同"在文章后面才 以"文化"为单位提及，且与本题定位句的论点无关。 交流中的身体接触暗示什么? A) 人们属于什么社会阶层。 B) 交流者有多文明。 C) 人们来自什么家庭背景。 D) 交流者的关系有多亲密。

questions.q: What does physical contact in communication suggest?
options: What social class people belong to.
How civilized the communicators are.
What family background people come from.
How close the communicators' relationships are.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does physical contact in communication suggest? 问"肢体接触暗示了什 么"，答案是原文一条直接陈述，不涉及全文主旨或作者态度。 47. What does physical contact in communication suggest? A) What social class people belong to. B) How civilized the communicators are. C) What family background people come from. D) How close the communicators' relationships are.

【拆句】Q47 是疑问句，主干 "physical contact ... suggest"，in communication 是介词短语作后 置定语修饰 physical contact。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Haptics in communication often suggest the level of intimacy. 沟通中的触觉行为常常暗示人际关系的亲密程度。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文谈的是 intimacy（亲密程度），没有涉及阶层。 B) 无中生有 原文谈的是亲密度、不是文明程度。 C) 无中生有 原文没有把肢体接触和家庭出身挂钩。 D) ✓ 正确 the level of intimacy ↔How close the communicators' relationships are 选项 How close the communicators' relationships are. 与预判"暗示亲密程度"完全等 值，且 communicators 与原文 in communication 呼应。 关于高接触文化中的人们,我们了解到什么? A) 他们对人们表达情感的方式很敏感。 B) 他们把触碰视为社会交往中的文化规范。 C) 他们非常重视人与人之间的紧密联系。 D) 他们在人际关系中往往更加开放。

questions.q: What do we learn about people in high-contact cultures?
options: They are sensitive to the way people express their emotions.
They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions.
They attach great importance to close ties among people.
They tend to be more open in interpersonal relationships.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn about people in high-contact cultures? 问"我们对高接触文化的 人了解到了什么"，要求复述原文对该群体的具体描述。

【拆句】Q48 主干 "What do we learn about people"，in high-contact cultures 是后置定语，限 定 people 的身份。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】People from the rest of the world, such as Latin America, are considered to be in high-contact cultures, where they tend to expect touching in social interactions and feel more comfortable with physical closeness. 世界其余地区的人，比如拉丁美洲，被认为属于高接触文化；在这种文化里，人们倾向于在 社交互动中期待触碰，并对身体上的亲近感觉更自在。 48. What do we learn about people in high-contact cultures? A) They are sensitive to the way people express their emotions. B) They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions. C) They attach great importance to close ties among people. D) They tend to be more open in interpersonal relationships.

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文没说他们对"情感表达方式"敏感，只说他们期待触碰本身。 B) ✓ 正确 they tend to expect touching in social interactions ↔ They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions 选项 They take touching as a cultural norm in social interactions. 等同于预判中 的"把触碰当社交常态"，且与原文 expect touching in social interactions 在介词短语 上一字不差。 C) 过度推断 原文只说"对身体接近觉得舒服"，没说他们"重视亲密的人际关系"——这是从触觉偏好 做的过度推论。 D) 过度推断 原文谈触碰频率、舒适度，没有谈"开放程度"这种性格倾向。 关于阿拉伯国家的社会习俗,我们了解到什么? A) 男性可以在公共场合通过身体亲昵表达友谊。 B) 非传统的恋爱关系完全不可接受。 C) 陌生人之间的身体接触被负面看待。 D) 不同年龄和性别的人以不同方式表达情感。

questions.q: What do we learn about social customs in Arabian countries?
options: Men can show friendship in public through physical affection.
Non-traditional romantic relationships are simply unacceptable.
Physical contact between unfamiliar people is negatively perceived.
People of different ages and genders show affection in different ways.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn about social customs in Arabian countries? 问"我们了解到阿拉 伯国家的社交风俗是什么"，原文有直接描述，属客观信息复述。

【拆句】Q49 主干 "What do we learn about social customs"，in Arabian countries 是后置定语 限定 social customs。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】In contrast, in certain Arabian, African, and Asian countries, men can publicly hold hands or show physical affection as signs of brotherhood or friendship while these behaviors may suggest a romantic relationship in other parts of the world. 相比之下，在某些阿拉伯、非洲和亚洲国家，男性可以公开牵手或表现身体上的亲热，作为 兄弟情谊或友谊的象征；而这些行为在世界其他地方则可能暗示着恋爱关系。 49. What do we learn about social customs in Arabian countries? A) Men can show friendship in public through physical affection. B) Non-traditional romantic relationships are simply unacceptable. C) Physical contact between unfamiliar people is negatively perceived. D) People of different ages and genders show affection in different ways.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 men can publicly hold hands or show physical affection as signs of brotherhood or friendship ↔ Men can show friendship in public through physical affection 选项 Men can show friendship in public through physical affection. 把定位句前半 句的所有要素重新排序后完整保留：主语 men、情态 can、动作公开化、目的友谊、手 段身体亲热，与预判一致。 B) 偷换概念 原文只说异性非家庭成员的肢体接触在阿拉伯国家被负面看待，没有讨论"非传统的恋爱 关系"。 C) 偷换概念 原文限制的是 persons of opposite sexes who are not family members（非家庭成员 的异性），而不是"不认识的人"——选项把性别条件偷换成了熟悉度。 D) 无中生有 原文只提性别，没说"不同年龄的人表达感情方式不同"。 作者告诉我们关于触觉交流应该做什么? A) 强调非语言交流。 B) 首先学会使用恰当的肢体语言。 C) 注意性别之间的差异。 D) 把他人的偏好考虑在内。

questions.q: What does the author tell us to do concerning tactile communication?
options: Lay emphasis on nonverbal communication.
Learn to use appropriate body language first.
Pay attention to the differences between genders.
Take other people's preference into consideration.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author tell us to do concerning tactile communication? 问"作者 就触觉沟通让我们做什么"，对应原文最后一句的建议，是直接陈述而非推断。

【拆句】Q50 主干 "What does the author tell us to do"，concerning tactile communication 是 concerning 引导的介词短语作状语，限定建议涉及的话题。concerning=关于。结构平 铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Therefore, if you are someone who loves to show physical affection, you should not be afraid to show it or drastically change your behaviors—just ask for consent beforehand! 因此，如果你是那种喜欢表现身体亲昵的人，你不必害怕表达，也不必大幅改变自己的行为 ——只要事先征得对方同意就好！ 50. What does the author tell us to do concerning tactile communication? A) Lay emphasis on nonverbal communication. B) Learn to use appropriate body language first. C) Pay attention to the differences between genders. D) Take other people's preference into consideration.

【选项】A) 答非所问 原文虽然第二段把肢体接触归在非言语沟通下，但末段并未让读者"侧重"非言语沟通 ——题目问的是末段的建议。 B) 无中生有 原文并未要求读者"先学会用恰当的肢体语言"——作者只让你"问"对方愿不愿意，并未 提学习这件事。 C) 以偏概全 原文第五段确实提及性别在拉美贴面礼中起作用 gender matters more for them，但 这是举例支撑"复杂因素"，并非作者最终给读者的建议。 D) ✓ 正确 just ask for consent beforehand ↔Take other people's preference into consideration 选项 Take other people's preference into consideration. 把作者末句的具体建议"事 先征得同意"抽象为"顾及他人偏好"，与预判方向一致，且未超出原文支持范围。

items.title: 2021年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.passage:
P1 From climate change to the ongoing pandemic(大流行病) and beyond, the issues facing today's world are increasingly complex and dynamic. Yet solving problems like these requires new approaches that extend beyond traditional ways of thinking. A study led by Yale Professor of Psychology, Paul O'Keefe, found that having a growth mindset(思维倾向) of interest may spark this type of innovation.

P2 Professor O'Keefe established in earlier studies that people hold different beliefs about the nature of interest. Those with a growth mindset of interest tend to believe that interests can be developed and cultivated, while those with a fixed mindset of interest tend to believe that interests are inherent(与生俱有的) and simply need to be 'found.' Building on these findings, the latest research examined how a growth mindset of interest can boost integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries of arts and sciences.

P3 For example, in one task, research participants were instructed to create new college majors by combining two or more existing academic Arts or Science programs at their university. After coding and analyzing the ideas they generated, the team found that people with a growth mindset of interest were more likely to bridge programs across the arts and sciences to create new majors like computational economics rather than creating majors that drew from only one of those areas, like computational chemistry.

P4 As Professor O'Keefe pointed out, "This research provides a useful direction for organizations whose products and services call for integrated and creative solutions. Take smartphones for example. You need not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design to create a better product. Employees with a growth mindset may be more likely to devise innovative ideas that bridge multiple areas of knowledge to achieve better solutions."

P5 The benefits of a growth mindset of interest may also extend to those seeking employment. This is a pressing issue because many people are becoming unemployed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Having a growth mindset of interest can help job seekers expand their interests and become more adaptable to different fields, and take the initiative to learn new skills.

questions.q: What does the author say about the world today?
options: It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated.
It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking.
It is undergoing radical and profound changes.
It is witnessing various types of innovations.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about the world today? 用 What does ... say about ... 直接 问对象的属性，没有 infer/suggest/imply 这类推断信号。 51. What does the author say about the world today? A) It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated. B) It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking. C) It is undergoing radical and profound changes. D) It is witnessing various types of innovations.

【拆句】What does the author say about the world today? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 the author say，介词短语 about the world today 限定 say 的内容；结构平铺直叙，无 陷阱。

【定位】From climate change to the ongoing pandemic and beyond, the issues facing today's world are increasingly complex and dynamic. 从气候变化到当下这场大流行病再到更远的将来，当今世界面临的问题愈发复杂多变。
